observations: Two yellow-green rectangular forms with red oval centers sit in the upper-left and upper-right corners, roughly mirroring each other against a black ground.
A dense tangle of black, white, yellow, blue, red, and lavender lines fills the middle zone, with jagged zigzag strokes alternating with loose looping coils.
The lower half shifts to a grid-like arrangement of red, orange, and blue rectangular outlines on a gray field, contrasting with the looser mark-making above.
reading: Two matching corner forms face each other across a field of competing line types — tight zigzags, open loops, slashing diagonals — that never settle into a single rhythm. The lower section pulls toward structure, its stacked rectangles reading as almost architectural, while the upper zone resists that order. The tension between those two areas gives the image an unsettled, pressurized feeling.
